What is the Facility Safety Map ?
This is a service that allows you to check and utilize various
 facility safety information around tour daily life at a glance on a
 map
Main information provided
Provides
the location and information of various
 public safety facilities such as shelters, evacuation
 facilities, and temporary housing facilities.
Safety Inspection and Diagnosis Results
You can
 check the safety inspection and diagnosis results of various
 facilities disclosed by the disaster management agency.
Life safety information
We provide thematic maps
 related to road facilities such as traffic and fire safety
 information.
How to use
If you select a desired field such as ‘evacuation facility’ on
 the field-specific map selection screen, you can check the
 location and detailed information of the facility on the map.
Search functionYou can search for the desired facility by
 address, keyword (e.g. convenience store, shelter, etc.), and
 subject map. History, status check: You can check the disaster
 occurrence history and status by region (1 to 5 grades).
Don't show up for a day

하천범람지도(국가하천)
하천범람지도는 하천이 범람하거나 붕괴되는 상황을 가정하여 하천주변의 예상침수범위와 침수깊이를
 표출하고 있습니다. 문의:한강홍수통제소 수자원정보센터(02-590-9975) (100년빈도
 데이터사용)
갱신일
2024.07

위치기준
기준
2001년 ~ 2024년 5월 31일
